title: Sprout Social Pricing 2026: Plans and Cost Per Seat
summary: Sprout Social pricing charges per-seat for four plans: three publicly available, one by request.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


Once you have the numbers, these are the questions that come up, and each answer points to the Sprout page that settles it.


### Trial and billing


There is a free trial but no permanent free plan. The trial is how you test the product, so use it on your real workflow. Check the sign-up flow on Sprout's pricing page for what the trial includes and how long it runs.


Paying annually is cheaper: Sprout's pricing page lists a lower rate for annual billing than for month-to-month. The catch is the commitment: you're paying for a year of seats whether or not you use them. Compare the two rates there before you pick one.


### Seats and add-ons


You can add extra users, because Sprout sells additional seats on top of each plan's included users, priced per person.


That's where a small team's bill quietly grows, so count every contractor and part-timer who needs a login. The pricing page shows the per-seat rate for each tier.


Whether AI features cost extra depends on the feature and your tier. Some AI tools are bundled into plans, while other capabilities, such as listening and premium analytics, are sold as separate add-ons.


Read Sprout's plan comparison line by line and ask sales to confirm in writing what your quote includes.


### Cancelling


Don't count on cancelling mid-contract. Sprout contracts are generally set up so that you commit for the term and renew automatically unless you give notice.


Read the renewal and cancellation language in your order form and in Sprout's terms of service, and put the notice date in your calendar the day you sign.
